name: podcast
description: A podcast or spoken audio program.
useCase: Identify a podcast program, subscription, or episode list beside its label.
misuse: Do not use the broadcast figure for microphone access or recording status.

16.reason: One broadcast arc leaves a clear head and separate shoulders; the smaller master omits the second arc to avoid merging the figure and waves.

24.reason: The larger head counter and concentric broadcast arcs preserve 1.5px of clear space between separate marks.
